questions.prompt: Is there a defect in how this code delivers webhooks and retries failed deliveries? If so, mark the line(s) where it is; otherwise answer that there is none.
enqueueWebhooks passes jobId: `${event.id}:${endpoint.id}`. What does this give the system?
choices: Jobs for the same endpoint are processed in strict order
If the same storage event is enqueued twice, BullMQ ignores the second add for each endpoint while the first job still exists
Each endpoint receives events at most once per hour
The worker can look up the endpoint secret from the job id

questions.prompt: A customer's endpoint returns HTTP 503 for every request for two days. What happens to a delivery for that endpoint?
choices: It is retried forever with growing delays
It is dropped after the first failure because 5xx responses are not retried
It is retried once after 10 seconds, then marked as completed
It is attempted up to 8 times with exponentially growing delays, then stays in the failed set for inspection and is not retried automatically

questions.prompt: fetch is called with redirect: "manual". What is the effect when a customer's endpoint answers with a 302 to another URL?
choices: The 302 is not followed; since it is not an ok status and is not retryable, the job fails permanently as a rejected delivery
The request is retried against the new URL with the same signature
The 302 is treated as success and the job completes
The worker follows redirects only for POST requests with a body
